Package org.dreambot.api.methods.construction

Class Servant

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Servant
  • public class Servant
extends java.lang.Object
    Calls a player-owned house servant, exchanges notes, fetches items from the bank and pays wages. XPE class.

    • Method Summary

      All Methods Static Methods Concrete Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method Description
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.NPC nearest()
      Gets the nearer of the loaded butler and demon butler. XPE method.
      Kind nearestKind()
      Gets the kind of the nearest loaded butler or demon butler, or NONE if neither is loaded. XPE method.
      boolean call()
      Clicks Call Servant in House Options or rings the bell-pull if the button is absent. Success means the call was made, not that the servant has arrived. XPE method.
      boolean unnote​(java.lang.String itemName, int amount)
      Uses a noted stack on the servant, confirms and enters the amount. Returns true when the noted count decreases. Refuses an offer to bank the notes. XPE method.
      boolean fetch​(java.lang.String itemName, int amount)
      Requests an item and quantity from the bank. True means the request was accepted, not delivered. A servant still holding the previous trip is thanked and the method returns false. XPE method.
      boolean pay​(int coins)
      Chooses the option that pays the specified number of coins instead of postponing payment or dismissing the servant. XPE method.
      boolean pay()
      Pays the servant's wage: 5,000 coins for a butler or 10,000 coins for a demon butler. XPE method.
      boolean isPaymentDue()
      Checks whether the servant is asking to be paid. XPE method.
      boolean isBankEmpty()
      Checks whether the servant says the bank has none of the requested item. XPE method.
      boolean isUnnoteQuestion()
      Checks for the servant's question about exchanging a certificate, including the option to bank the notes. XPE method.
